datasets.title: Terracotta Vessel
datasets.description: A hand-built vessel model with ochre bands and a complete set of material files.
datasets.layout: Deeply nested OBJ and MTL with a texture subfolder
datasets.creator: Digital Humanities Jena

datasets.title: Painted Floor Tile
datasets.description: A glazed tile model with a transposed letter in its texture reference. WebHDP reconnects the correct image.
datasets.layout: glTF with separate binary and image folders
datasets.creator: Digital Humanities Jena

datasets.title: Bronze Seal
datasets.description: A stamped seal model without its surface texture. WebHDP keeps the geometry and uses the bronze material colour.
datasets.layout: Root-level OBJ and MTL, with optional texture absent
datasets.creator: Digital Humanities Jena

datasets.title: Glazed Bowl
datasets.description: A shallow ceramic bowl with a moved glaze image and a damaged detail texture. WebHDP reconnects the glaze and omits the damaged map.
datasets.layout: OBJ and MTL with separate surface assets
datasets.texture_status: Moved glaze image and damaged detail map
datasets.creator: Digital Humanities Jena
